sources.excerpt: Lazy J x ThorpyFX The J review: a superb tweed amp emulation | Guitar.com News Reviews Guides Features Magazine Tuner Deals Related Brands Lazy J ThorpyFX Related Tags # Effects # Overdrive # Pedals When you purchase through affiliate links on Guitar.com, you may contribute to our site through commissions. Learn more Featured Deal Sterling By Music Man Sabre – save a massive $500 on this dent and scratch model at Sweetwater Claim Reviews Lazy J x ThorpyFX The J review: “one of the best sounding, most tactile and responsive dirt pedals I’ve ever played” Have you ever felt the need for Tweed but not the cash to splash? This collab from two UK boutique heavyweights promises to put classic vintage amp tones in your rig for a fraction of the price Lazy J x ThorpyFX The J. Image: Press by Ed Oleszko January 14, 2026 by Ed Oleszko January 14, 2026 When you purchase through affiliate links on Guitar.com, you may contribute to our site through commissions. Learn more Review Overview Our rating 10 Our verdict ⊕ Boutique Tweed tones in a box ⊕ More versatile than you’d imagine ⊕ Incredibly responsive and good purely as a drive pedal ⊖ A real valve version would be a nice extension of the format The J crucially captures not only the ‘Tweed Tone’ perfectly but crucially the feel and response of plugging into a real Tweed Lazy J20 amp. One of the most organic, touch sensitive and responsive overdrive pedals around £329 / $399, thorpyfx.com Collabs are all the rage in the pedal world these days, but it’s still exciting when you see someone enter the field that hasn’t been there before. Jesse Hoff, the main man behind Lazy J , has won a reputation as one of the world’s foremost boutique amp makers over the last few decades. You’ll find his takes on vintage Tweed amps on stages and in studios with everyone from David Gilmour and Noel Gallagher to Ed O’Brien and Joe Satriani . READ MORE: Horrothia Effects Triage Deluxe review – the ultimate all-in-one gain machine for fussy tonehounds? Hoff is also no stranger to effects either, having put out the well-regarded Cruiser boost/drive pedal well over a decade ago. But collaborations? That’s a new one. Thorpy main man Adrian Thorpe is much more familiar with that sort of thing of course – whether that’s making signature gear for Chris Buck and Danish Pete , or collaborating with pedal legend Dan Coggins to revive both the Dinosaural and Lovetone brands. Two tone connoisseurs teaming up to make something altogether a bit different for both of them then? Well, that sounds like a lot of fun… “I like to work with good people who genuinely inspire me,” Thorpe tells me. “Jesse is such a great guy, one of the great amp builders. I’ve been an owner and huge fan of his Lazy J J 20 amp for years. It’s such a harmonically rich and beautifully tactile amp to play. It’s taken us about four years of collaboration to develop The J pedal, and we’re really proud of the result.” Image: Press Lazy J x Thorpy Fx The J – what is it? As Adrian implies, the primary mission of The J is to faithfully emulate the tones and response of a J 20 amp in compact pedal format, itself derived from the classic Fender 5E3 Tweed Deluxe amp. To do that, The J includes a built-in transformer that can mimic the real amp feel, paired with a circuit chock full of high-grade audiophile capacitors and such. All of it is built to Thorpy’s famously military-grade specs, and differs from the usual Thorpy fare by squeezing it all into a rather lovely UV-printed enclosure. It’s still recognisably a Thorpy pedal of course, but one that feels equally indebted to the Lazy J boutique amp lineage. As with the original, you get the option of a normal or bright channel, and the controls are suitably spartan for an amp based on the similarly simple J 20 – with independent volume for each, as well as a presence control, single tone and a master output. sources.excerpt: New Pedal: ThorpyFX The J Overdrive (Lazy J Amps' Collab) | Delicious Audio Creative Pedals Creative Delay Tape Delay W/ Reverb Delay Distortion Fuzz Overdrive Dual Gain Dirt Boost Compr. + Dynamics Dynamics EQ Filter Wah Filter+EQ Lo-Fi 8 Bit Lo-fi Chorus Flanger Phaser Tremolo Uni-Vibe Modulation Pitch Shifter Octaver pitch Multiverb Reverb Spring Reverb Reverb CV In Granular Synth Pedals Synth Effect Guides Monthly Lists Shopping Guides Coverage Schedule Facebook Stompbox Exhibit New Pedal: ThorpyFX The J Overdrive (Lazy J Amps’ collab) Updated Nov. 5, 2025  |  by Paolo De Gregorio The ThorpyFX The Ji is the second in the British company’s Analog Amp Emulator Series and the result of a collaboration with amp wizard Jesse Hoff of Lazy J Amps. Its mission is simple: to bottle the elusive, touch-sensitive magic of Hoff’s legendary Lazy J20 combo . This pedal goes beyond simple circuit modeling. By incorporating a high-quality internal transformer, “The J” replicates the authentic sag, punch, and dynamic response of a real tweed amplifier. The control set is a player’s paradise, featuring dual Normal and Bright channel volumes, a Tone control, a Response knob for presence, and a unique Supply control that lets you dial in the voltage sag for anything from clean headroom to compressed vintage breakup. A standout feature is the X/Y footswitch , which toggles between emulated 12AX7 and 12AY7 input tubes. This shifts the entire character of the pedal from cleaner, chiming tones to raw, medium-gain drive. Built in the UK with premium components, “The J” is designed to be the last amp-emulating pedal you’ll ever need, offering a truly responsive and organic playing experience right on your pedalboard.
